bugs.description: Additional services prices are always shown in USD regardless of the flight booking currency.
bugs.title: Additional services prices always displayed in USD regardless of booking currency
bugs.observed_behavior: All prices in the additional services panel (seat upgrades, extra baggage, meals, etc.) are shown with the USD symbol, even when the flight booking is denominated in a different currency such as EUR or TRY.
bugs.expected_behavior: Prices in the additional services panel should be displayed in the same currency that was used when the flight was selected, providing a consistent and correct total price calculation.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open the application homepage.
2. Select 'Round trip'.
3. Enter 'Ankara' as departure and 'Paris' as arrival.
4. Select 15 April as the departure date and 23 April as the return date.
5. Set passenger count to 1 and click 'Search'.
6. Select a flight for departure.
7. Select a flight for arrival.
8. Fill in the passenger details and proceed.
9. On the seat and additional services screen, observe the currency symbol shown next to each price.

bugs.description: Searching for flights from Ankara to İzmir shows an error modal and blocks navigation to the availability page.
bugs.title: Ankara to İzmir flight search blocked — error modal shown instead of results
bugs.observed_behavior: After clicking 'Search' with Ankara as origin and İzmir as destination, a modal error dialog appears and the application does not navigate to the availability page. The user cannot proceed with booking this route.
bugs.expected_behavior: Searching for flights from Ankara (ESB) to İzmir (ADB) should navigate to the availability page and display available flights, the same as any other origin–destination pair.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open the application homepage.
2. Select 'One way' trip type.
3. Click the departure city field and type 'Ankara' — select 'Ankara Esenboğa (ESB)' from the dropdown.
4. Click the destination field and type 'İzmir' — select 'İzmir Gaziemir (ADB)' from the dropdown.
5. Select any future departure date.
6. Click 'Search'.
7. Observe that an error modal appears instead of navigating to the flight results page.

bugs.description: Clicking the '+' button in the passenger selector has no effect and the count stays at 1.
bugs.title: Passenger count increment control has no effect on search form
bugs.observed_behavior: Clicking the '+' button next to the passenger count in the search form does not change the displayed number. The count remains at 1 regardless of how many times the control is clicked.
bugs.expected_behavior: Clicking the '+' button should increase the passenger count by 1 each time it is clicked, up to the maximum allowed, so users can search for multi-passenger bookings.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open the application homepage.
2. In the flight search form, locate the 'Passengers' selector — it defaults to 1 adult passenger with '-' and '+' controls.
3. Click the '+' button to increase the passenger count.
4. Observe that the count displayed does not change and remains at 1.

bugs.description: The booking confirmation total only shows seat and service fees, omitting the base flight fare.
bugs.title: Booking confirmation total excludes flight fare — only shows seat and service fees
bugs.observed_behavior: On the payment confirmation screen, the displayed total price only includes the charges for optional seat selection and additional services. The base flight ticket price is not included, making the total incorrect.
bugs.expected_behavior: The total amount on the confirmation page should reflect the full booking cost: base flight fare plus any seat or additional service fees.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open the application homepage.
2. Select 'Round trip', enter 'Ankara' as departure and 'Paris' as arrival.
3. Choose 15 April as departure and 23 April as return, set 1 passenger, and click 'Search'.
4. Select a flight for departure and another for arrival.
5. Fill in the passenger details and proceed.
6. Select a seat and at least one additional service, then click 'Continue'.
7. Fill in payment details, accept the terms of service, and click 'Complete booking'.
8. On the confirmation page, observe that the price shown only covers seats and additional services, not the full fare.

bugs.description: Ticking the terms of service checkbox alone triggers 'Payment ready to submit' even when all payment fields are empty.
bugs.title: Accepting terms of service without payment details incorrectly shows 'Payment ready to submit'
bugs.observed_behavior: Ticking the terms of service checkbox on the payment page immediately updates the status indicator to 'Payment ready to submit', even when the card number, expiry date, and security code fields are all empty.
bugs.expected_behavior: The 'Payment ready to submit' status should only appear when both the terms of service are accepted AND all required payment fields are validly filled in. Accepting terms alone should not trigger this state.
bugs.s2r:
1. Navigate to the payment page (complete the search, flight selection, and passenger details steps to reach it).
2. Leave all payment fields (card number, expiry, security code, cardholder name) empty.
3. Tick the 'I accept the terms of service' checkbox.
4. Observe that the status indicator changes to 'Payment ready to submit' despite no payment details being entered.

bugs.description: Payment card fields (card number, expiry, security code) accept and display non-numeric characters instead of rejecting them.
bugs.title: Payment card fields accept non-numeric characters
bugs.observed_behavior: Typing a letter (e.g., 'a', 'B') into the card number, expiry date, or security code field is accepted and the character is rendered visibly in the input. No validation or filtering occurs at the input level.
bugs.expected_behavior: Non-numeric keystrokes should be silently ignored on the card number, expiry, and security code fields. Only digit characters (0–9) should be allowed through.
bugs.s2r:
1. Navigate to the payment page.
2. Click the 'Card Number' input field.
3. Type a letter (e.g., press the 'A' key).
4. Observe that the letter appears in the field.
5. Repeat for the 'Expiry Date' and 'Security Code' fields.

bugs.description: The 'Increasing by price' sort orders flights from most to least expensive, which is the opposite of what the label says.
bugs.title: 'Increasing by price' sort displays flights in descending price order
bugs.observed_behavior: After clicking the 'Increasing by price' sort button, the flight list reorders so the most expensive fares appear at the top and the cheapest at the bottom. The button is highlighted as active, suggesting the sort was applied correctly when it was not.
bugs.expected_behavior: Clicking 'Increasing by price' should sort the displayed flights from lowest to highest economy fare, placing the cheapest option first.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open the application homepage.
2. Search for any flight (e.g., Istanbul → London, any future date, 1 passenger).
3. On the availability page, locate the sort controls.
4. Click the 'Increasing by price' button.
5. Observe the order of fares — they appear from most expensive to least expensive, contrary to the label.

bugs.description: After a flight change, prepaid seat assignments vanish from the itinerary while the seat fee remains charged.
bugs.title: Prepaid seat assignments disappear after flight change while seat fee remains charged
bugs.observed_behavior: Once a flight change is simulated, all Turkish Airlines legs in the booked itinerary show 'Seat assignment missing'. The seat fee is still displayed in the price breakdown but the assigned seats are gone and cannot be recovered from the UI.
bugs.expected_behavior: If a flight change invalidates a seat assignment, the system should either re-assign an equivalent seat automatically or initiate a refund flow for the seat fee. At minimum, the assigned seat should remain visible until the passenger is actively notified of the change.
bugs.s2r:
1. Complete a full booking on the application (search, select flights, fill passenger details, select seats, complete payment).
2. Open a new tab and navigate to the admin panel at '/admin'.
3. Click 'Trigger seat reset' to simulate a flight change in the background.
4. Return to the main application and open the signed-in user profile from the top-right avatar.
5. Inspect the ticket legs for the Turkish Airlines itinerary.
6. Observe that all seat assignments show as missing, while the seat fee is still listed in the price breakdown.

bugs.description: Selecting 'Stopover in Istanbul' silently overrides the user's chosen destination with Antalya before the search is submitted.
bugs.title: Stopover in Istanbul trip type silently overrides destination to Antalya
bugs.observed_behavior: After selecting 'Stopover in Istanbul', entering a destination (e.g., London), and clicking 'Search', the availability page URL and displayed results correspond to Antalya, not to the city the user entered.
bugs.expected_behavior: The 'Stopover in Istanbul' trip type should add Istanbul as an intermediate stop on the way to the user's selected destination, not replace that destination. The availability page should show flights to the city the user actually typed.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open the application homepage.
2. Select 'Stopover in Istanbul' as the trip type.
3. Enter any departure city (e.g., 'Istanbul').
4. Enter any destination other than Antalya (e.g., 'London Heathrow (LHR)').
5. Select a departure date.
6. Click 'Search'.
7. On the availability page, check the page heading and URL — observe the destination has been changed to Antalya.

bugs.description: Using Shift+Home after Shift+Left Arrow to extend a selection drops the last character from the selected range.
bugs.title: Text selection bug: Shift + Home drops the last character if initially selected via Shift + Left Arrow
bugs.observed_behavior: When typing text on an empty page, selecting the last character with Shift + Left Arrow and then pressing Shift + Home results in all characters in the line being selected except for the very last character.
bugs.expected_behavior: Pressing Shift + Home while holding a selection on the last character should expand the selection to the entire line of text, including that last character.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open Notion and create a new empty page.
2. Type a single line of text.
3. Ensure the text cursor is positioned at the very end of the line.
4. Press 'Shift + Left Arrow' to select the last character.
5. While still holding the 'Shift' key, press the 'Home' key.
6. Observe that the selection highlights the line but drops the initially selected last character.

bugs.description: Typing 'Lisbon' in the destination field returns no results, leading the user to believe the city is not served.
bugs.title: Lisbon does not appear in destination search results when typed in English
bugs.observed_behavior: When 'Istanbul' is selected as departure and the user types 'Lisbon' (or partial text such as 'Lis') into the destination field, no matching city appears in the autocomplete dropdown.
bugs.expected_behavior: Typing 'Lisbon' should surface Lisbon, Portugal as a destination option in the search results.
bugs.s2r:
1. Open the Turkish Airlines website.
2. Select 'Istanbul' as the departure city.
3. Click the destination field and type 'Lisbon'.
4. Observe that no city appears in the autocomplete dropdown.
bugs.fix_suggestion: This is not a bug. The Turkish Airlines destination search uses Turkish city names. Lisbon is called 'Lizbon' in Turkish — type 'Lizbon' in the destination field and the city will appear correctly in the dropdown.

bugs.description: Navigation menu items randomly disappear and reappear on each page load with no consistent set of elements.
bugs.title: Navigation elements disappear and reappear randomly on page refresh
bugs.observed_behavior: On each page load, one or more navigation items (e.g., Gallery, Portfolio, Contact Us) are missing from the menu. The set of visible elements changes non-deterministically between refreshes — elements present on one load may be absent on the next.
bugs.expected_behavior: The navigation menu should render a consistent, complete set of elements on every page load regardless of how many times the page is refreshed.
bugs.s2r:
1. Navigate to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/disappearing_elements.
2. Observe the navigation menu items displayed on the page.
3. Refresh the page.
4. Observe the navigation menu again — note that one or more items may now be missing.
5. Repeat steps 3–4 at least five times and observe that the set of visible menu items changes randomly on each load.

bugs.description: The navigation menu stays fixed at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling and never moves with the page content.
bugs.title: Navigation menu remains visible at top of page while scrolling down
bugs.observed_behavior: After scrolling all the way to the bottom of the page, the navigation menu remains anchored at the top of the viewport and does not scroll away with the rest of the content.
bugs.expected_behavior: The navigation menu was expected to scroll away with the page content as the user scrolls down, eventually disappearing from view.
bugs.s2r:
1. Navigate to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/floating_menu.
2. Observe the navigation menu at the top of the page.
3. Slowly scroll down to the bottom of the page.
4. Observe that the navigation menu remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the entire scroll.

bugs.description: Images are broken and sorting is not working.
bugs.title: Product images broken and sort dropdown non-functional
bugs.observed_behavior: All product images on the inventory page display the same unrelated dog photograph instead of the actual product images. Additionally, selecting any sort option from the 'Sort products' dropdown (e.g., 'Price (low to high)') does not reorder the product list — the order remains unchanged.
bugs.expected_behavior: Each product should display its correct product image. Selecting a sort option should reorder the product list according to the chosen criterion.
bugs.s2r:
1. Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com.
2. Enter 'problem_user' as the username and 'secret_sauce' as the password, then click 'Login'.
3. Observe that all product images show a dog photo instead of product images.
4. Open the 'Sort products' dropdown in the top-right of the inventory page.
5. Select 'Price (low to high)'.
6. Observe that the product list order does not change.

bugs.description: Last Name field in the checkout form is unresponsive.
bugs.title: Last Name field in checkout form does not accept input
bugs.observed_behavior: When filling in the checkout information form, clicking the 'Last Name' field and typing produces no characters in the input. The field appears focused but remains empty regardless of what the user types, preventing checkout from being completed.
bugs.expected_behavior: The Last Name field should accept keyboard input and display the typed text, allowing the user to proceed through checkout.
bugs.s2r:
1. Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com.
2. Log in with username 'error_user' and password 'secret_sauce'.
3. Add any product to the cart and click the cart icon.
4. Click 'Checkout'.
5. On the 'Checkout: Your Information' screen, click the 'Last Name' field.
6. Type any text.
7. Observe that no characters appear in the Last Name field.

bugs.description: Logging in as visual_user shows 'Add to cart' buttons overflowing outside the product card boundaries, and the cart icon is displaced in the header.
bugs.title: visual_user: 'Add to cart' button overflows product card boundary, cart icon displaced
bugs.observed_behavior: On the inventory page, the 'Add to cart' button renders outside the boundaries of its product card, visually breaking the card layout. Additionally, the shopping cart icon in the page header is not in its expected position and appears displaced.
bugs.expected_behavior: The 'Add to cart' button should be contained within the product card. The cart icon should be correctly positioned in the header.
bugs.s2r:
1. Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com.
2. Log in with username 'visual_user' and password 'secret_sauce'.
3. On the inventory page, inspect the product cards.
4. Observe that the 'Add to cart' button extends beyond the card boundary instead of being contained within it.
5. Observe that the shopping cart icon in the top-right header is displaced from its expected position.
